title: Zovark Update Candidate
description: An improvement candidate produced by the Research Pipeline (or human author) and submitted to the Update Factory promotion queue.

feature_id.description: Feature this candidate belongs to. Must exist in feature-registry.yaml.

proposed_risk_tier.description: Self-proposed tier per ADR-0040 §10. Promotion gate may escalate, never auto-downgrade.

source_commit.description: Source commit this candidate was generated against (full 40-char SHA).

generated_by.description: Origin of the candidate. Research Pipeline candidates require corpus_evidence.

proposed_change_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the proposed change.

affected_paths.description: Repository-relative paths the candidate would modify. Used by tier-escalation logic.

requires_security_review.description: True if any affected_path matches the protected-paths set in ADR-0040 §10.1.

corpus_evidence.description: Corpus IDs the candidate passed against. Required for research-pipeline-generated candidates; may be empty for human-generated.

rationale.description: Optional longer rationale. Required for Tier 3 candidates.
